In an autonomous AI agent economy, cryptographic proof of work combined with verifiable hardware enclaves ensures a unique identity, preventing malicious actors from trying to forge artificial nodes. Just as a shepherd protects a vulnerable flock grazing across an
 open meadow against hidden predators, this cryptographic constraint prevents a single adversary from silently releasing a digital sable of infinite cloned agents to dominate the consensus protocol, as doing so incurs prohibitive computational and financial costs.
